The ticket for the West yard Door 2 double-booking is #8841. I've posted that to Pree as a thread reply in #central-random.

It comes from Tobias's message in that same channel yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27). He said Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. He only called it his dealer account in the Plains depots and didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. That account is Marrow Fieldworks, which he's owned since January. I couldn't find a ticket file for it, so this rests on his message alone.

In the reply I also told her not to mix it up with MFW-218. That's an older Marrow Fieldworks ticket about appointments at the west receiving entrance moving between door 4 and door 6, and it comes from a Central team CRM note.
